subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “But for Mark, that was the point.”?
options: People need quiet spaces before the world enters.
Some small objects help people rest because they hold a quiet world that does not hurry.
A map can help people understand the world, but it can also quietly teach them where they think the center is.
Still, people remembered the small one because it had shown a quiet kind of kindness: making room for others even when it costs comfort.
